Entries.Name: Kweebec Merchant
Entries.Line: Some of the stuff I have sells really fast. Other things have been sitting here for months.

Entries.Name: Kweebec Merchant
Entries.Line: Take this bottle, for example. You can use it for lots of things: storing water, some kinds of food, interesting bugs you find...

Entries.Name: Kweebec Merchant
Entries.Line: But then you have all these golden doodads. What *can* you use them for? They're objectively more useless than bottles, and yet...
